images.prompt: Wide editorial hero photograph matching page 2 subject precisely, layered depth, natural color, ample edge detail for crop, no embedded text.
Editorial wide scene specific to page 3, key subject on left third, clean negative space on right, believable light and textures.

images.prompt: Close editorial detail that visibly demonstrates the page 4 concept, portrait composition, sharp focal detail and soft background falloff.

images.prompt: Portrait editorial detail precisely corresponding to page 5, tactile realism, controlled palette and natural shadows.

Instructional editorial image showing the exact page 7 action and result in one readable landscape frame, realistic hands and objects.

images.prompt: Tall portrait feature for page 8, subject fully visible, bottom-weighted composition with safe title space above, natural editorial finish.
Extra-wide page 9 comparison scene, primary detail on right, consistent styling with prior images, adequate resolution for A4 placement.
Polished closing editorial photograph that resolves the ebook narrative, calm premium lighting, cohesive palette, generous clean crop margins.
